KnowledgeBaseChunk.description_en: The information of a single chunk in a knowledge base document, including the chunk content, sequence number, title path, and enabled status
KnowledgeBaseChunk.description_zh: 知识库文档的单个切片信息，包含切片正文、序号、标题路径与启用状态

ChunkSeq.description_en: The sequence number of the chunk within the document, starting from 1 and numbered consecutively
ChunkSeq.description_zh: 切片在文档内的序号，从 1 开始连续编号
ChunkSeq.title: 切片序号

ChunkSize.description_en: The number of characters in the chunk content, measured in UTF-16 code units, consistent with MaxChunkSize. You can use this value to evaluate chunk saturation against the chunking configuration
ChunkSize.description_zh: 切片正文的字符数，与 MaxChunkSize 同口径（UTF-16 码元数），可用于对照分块配置评估切片饱和度
ChunkSize.title: 切片大小

Content.example: EventBridge 支持将事件路由到多种目标服务。
Content.title: 切片正文

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the chunk was created
CreatedAt.title: 创建时间

DocumentId.description_en: The ID of the document to which the chunk belongs
DocumentId.title: 文档 ID

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the chunk is enabled. Disabled chunks are excluded from retrieval
Enabled.description_zh: 切片是否启用。禁用的切片不参与检索
Enabled.title: 是否启用

FileName.description_en: The file name of the document to which the chunk belongs. This value is from the same source as the FileName returned by GetDocument
FileName.description_zh: 切片所属文档的文件名，与 GetDocument 回显的 FileName 同源
FileName.title: 文件名

SourceLocation.description_en: The location of the chunk in the original document. The format varies by document type: for PDF, the value is p.PageNumber (such as p.3). For PPT/PPTX, the value is s.SlideNumber (such as s.2). For XLS/XLSX, the value is the sheet name. For other formats (such as txt, md, html, doc, or docx), this field is not returned if no source location is available
SourceLocation.description_zh: 切片在原文中的位置，随文档格式不同：PDF 为 p.页码（如 p.3），PPT/PPTX 为 s.幻灯片序号（如 s.2），XLS/XLSX 为工作表名，其余格式（txt/md/html/doc/docx 等）无来源定位时不返回
SourceLocation.title: 来源定位

TitlePath.description_en: The hierarchical title path of the chunk, connected by >. If no recognizable title exists in the original document, the value falls back to a summary of the first paragraph content (such as CONTENT). This field is for display purposes only
TitlePath.description_zh: 切片所属标题层级路径，使用 > 连接。原文无可识别标题时降级为首段内容摘要（如 CONTENT），仅用于展示
TitlePath.title: 标题路径

UpdatedAt.description_en: The time when the chunk was last updated
UpdatedAt.title: 最近更新时间

KnowledgeBaseChunk.title: 知识库切片

description_en: Lists text chunks in a knowledge base bound to a Luma Agent, with support for filtering by document, keyword, and enabled status
description_zh: 列出 Luma Agent 绑定的知识库中的文本块，支持按文档、关键词和启用状态过滤
name: ListLumaChunks

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaCatalogs to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaNamespaces to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的命名空间名称。可通过 ListLumaNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaKnowledgeBases to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的知识库名称。可通过 ListLumaKnowledgeBases 获取
parameters.name: knowledge_base_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the document used to filter text chunks. If this parameter is not specified, text chunks of all documents in the knowledge base are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按文档过滤。不传则返回知识库内全部文档的文本块
parameters.name: document_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter text chunks by content
parameters.help_zh: 按文本块内容中的关键词过滤
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only enabled text chunks. If this parameter is not specified, text chunks are not filtered by enabled status
parameters.help_zh: 不传则不按启用状态过滤
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. If this parameter is not specified, the server uses a default value
parameters.help_zh: 取值范围 1~100，不传时由服务端取默认值
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response. This value is an opaque string. Do not parse it
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询不传；后续翻页使用上一次响应中返回的 NextToken。该值为不透明字符串，请勿解析
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call succeeded. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The chunk list result, which contains chunk entries and pagination information
Data.description_zh: 切片列表，包含切片条目与分页信息

items.description_en: The details of a single chunk, including the chunk sequence number, body, title path, and enabled status
items.description_zh: 单个切片的详细信息，包含切片序号、正文、标题路径与启用状态

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page (an opaque string). Pass this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页翻页令牌（不透明字符串），传入下次请求的 NextToken 可获取下一页；为空表示已无更多数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一页起始Token，为空表示已是最后一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页起始Token，为空表示已是最后一页

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of chunks in the document
TotalCount.title_en: 符合条件的文本块总数
TotalCount.title_zh: 符合条件的文本块总数

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value is Operation success if the call succeeds, or a specific error description if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Use this ID for troubleshooting and when submitting a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
